newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates, one-week up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates, one-week up.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Tuesday in the private sector to between 7-1/2 and 9-1/4 percent from around seven percent on Thursday, the last working day before a four-day holiday, bankers said.
"Overnight rates went up because lenders wanted to lend for four days while borrowers asked for just overnight," a banker said. Banks are closed on Thursday, May 1.

Most bankers said they did not make one-week deals because they would cover only two working days. But a banker at one of the most active banks said he dealt at eight percent, up from seven percent on Thursday.
Public sector banks maintained their 10-1/2 percent rate.
